# DistEsmWorkspaceBoot packs the working tree's ignored files since prepack composes .npmignore

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/core/DistEsmWorkspaceBoot.spec.mjs` fails in a working tree since #19223 (merged 09-25). In #17844's census at dev `a9abb6c1dc`, its `beforeAll` dies at `:140`:

```
npm pack --json --ignore-scripts --loglevel=error --pack-destination …
npm error code ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE
npm error data is too long            (ssri fromData → Hash.update: the tarball outgrows one hash update)
```

CI stays green at the same head (run 36230911025, `e2e-engine (1/3)`), because a CI checkout holds almost nothing that git ignores.

## The Problem

#19223 moved the `.gitignore` copy out of the committed `.npmignore` (177 → 40 lines) into `prepack`. `--ignore-scripts` skips `prepack`, so the spec's pack reads the header alone and packs everything the working tree holds and git ignores. After a full census that includes `test/playwright/test-results/` (3.7 GiB), `tmp/` (135 MiB) and `.env`. The tarball overflows, and when it doesn't, the spec boots a package a publish would never ship.

## The Architectural Reality

#19223 added `withComposedNpmIgnore(root, fn)` (`buildScripts/util/npmIgnoreComposition.mjs`) for exactly this case, "a pack that passes `--ignore-scripts`", and migrated `buildScripts/util/check-consumer-runtime-build.mjs:343`. This spec is the one `--ignore-scripts` pack it did not migrate. Keeping `--ignore-scripts` is right: `prepare` runs the skills materializer, which a test must not run.

## The Fix

Wrap the spec's `execFileSync('npm', ['pack', …])` in `withComposedNpmIgnore(engineRoot, () => …)`. Measured on the census tree: the wrapped pack is 5,805 entries and 26.8 MiB, with no `test-results`, no `.env`, and `dist/parse5.mjs` present, and `.npmignore` is restored afterwards.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: at the head, in a tree holding the census's `test-results/`, the spec's four arms pass (headless, `--workers=1`).
- [ ] AC-2: red-first, the same tree at the head without the wrap fails `beforeAll` with `ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE`.
- [ ] AC-3: `git status` shows `.npmignore` unchanged after the run.

## Out of Scope

- `npmIgnoreComposition.mjs` itself: it already has the seam.
- The rest of #17844's census, refreshed on #17844.
